name: Despertar
storyline:
In the year 2020... A catastrophe occurs.

A pandemic afflicts humanity. Thousands die as a result of this virus, whose origin is unknown. The government urges the population to use masks and maintain social distancing of 6 feet away, to prevent the transmission of the disease.

The virus spreads among the masses. Nobody obeys protection and prevention guidelines. The most severe symptoms are high levels of uncontrolled libido and a clotting syndrome. Many people develop aneurysms in the brain and unfortunately they die.

With society unraveling and the truth behind the outbreak still unknown, one question remains:

Can anything stop it… or is it already too late?
summary: The pandemic continues the deployment curve, but when the people gather is when this virus spreads the most intensity. This is the story of one of the many people who was a victim of this virus from Bayamón, Puerto Rico.
